description: A PHP framework where htmx lives in PHP classes, not HTML.

extra.//branch-alias: Composer's default stability for a `dev-` version is dev, which is what we want: nothing here should ever read as a release. The alias makes the resolved version legible (0.1.9999999-dev) instead of the literal string `dev-main`, and records an intent — pre-1.0, no promises — that a bare branch name does not. No git tag is used, because a tag cannot move and would need a constraint bump plus a re-lock in every consumer for each change. 0.x on its own would NOT have worked: Composer parses 0.1.0 and 0.0.1 as stable, so a 0.x tag would mark a release. See dev/planning/CHECKLIST.md §6.
